title: Benjamin Franklin “Z-Grill” Stamp, 500 CFA francs, WORLD’S MOST VALUABLE STAMPS
descriptionPlain: Description In 1868, the United States issued an experimental series of postage stamps featuring the grill pattern — a grid of embossed cuts designed to prevent reuse. The variant with horizontal impressions, known as the Z-Grill, has survived in only two copies. One is held in the collections of the New York Public Library, while the other sold at auction in 2024 for a record $4.3 million. This coin faithfully recreates the appearance of the stamp, highlighting its distinctive pattern and exceptional place in philatelic history.
